lines.en: label beachfive11:
scene chikabeachtouka1
: {i}Haaah...{/i}
: This sucks...
lines.zh: : 真烂……

lines.en: : He didn’t even come look for me.
lines.zh: : 他连找我都没来找我。

lines.en: : Is it the hair?...I bet he hates it. I should have asked him first. Dumb idea, Chika. Fucking {i}stupid{/i} idea. What were you thinking?
lines.zh: : 是因为头发吗？……我猜他讨厌这个发型。我应该先问过他的。蠢主意，Chika。真他妈的{i}蠢{/i}主意。你当时在想什么？

lines.en: Chika Chosokabe had been having a tough time lately. So tough, in fact, that she’d taken to tossing grains of sand over her shoulder as part of the world’s longest game of “He loves me, he loves me not.”
lines.zh: Chika Chosokabe 最近过得很艰难。艰难到她已经开始把沙粒从肩头往后抛，作为史上最长的一局「他爱我、他不爱我」的一部分。

lines.en: When there was no sand left in front of her, she’d finally have an answer. But by then there would be a mountain so large behind her that it would very likely spill forward and bury her completely.
lines.zh: 等到她面前再没有沙子的时候，她终于会得到一个答案。可到那时，她身后的沙堆已经高得像座山，极可能会向前倾泻，把她整个人埋掉。

lines.en: Right now, that wouldn’t be entirely unwelcome. She was smitten beyond all belief — and the one thing she wanted in this very moment was for the one {i}person{/i} she wants to just {i}acknowledge{/i} her.
lines.zh: 就此刻而言，那也并非完全不可接受。她已经神魂颠倒到了难以置信的地步——而她此刻唯一想要的，就是她想要的那个「{i}人{/i}」能稍稍{i}注意到{/i}她。

lines.en: He had barely done that at all lately. He’d been nothing short of a changed man following his time in a makeshift prison. But what she {i}didn’t{/i} know is that this was {i}proof{/i} of his love.
lines.zh: 而最近他几乎没有那么做过。在那个临时搭起的牢房里待过之后，他简直变了一个人。但她不知道的是，这恰恰是他爱的{i}证明{/i}。

lines.en: What she didn’t know is that the man she wishes she could tie a rope around felt {i}guilty{/i} being near her because it made him feel like he was betraying someone else.
lines.zh: 她不知道的是，那个她恨不得用绳子拴住的男人，靠近她时会感到{i}愧疚{/i}，因为那让他觉得自己正在背叛另一个人。

lines.en: He thought that if he could just stay away, Chika’s feelings would begin to fade. But what he did {i}not{/i} know is just how tenacious this girl was.
lines.zh: 他以为只要自己躲得远远的，Chika 的感情就会开始淡去。但他所不知道的是，这个女孩有多么执拗。

lines.en: Chika Chosokabe could take a beating — both sexually and mentally. And the amount of pain she could withstand in both respects would make {i}anyone{/i} envious.
lines.zh: Chika Chosokabe 经得起挨打——无论是性方面还是精神方面。而她在这两方面能承受的痛苦，会让{i}任何人{/i}嫉妒。

lines.en: But of course that didn’t mean she was {i}fine.{/i}
lines.zh: 当然，这并不代表她就{i}没事{/i}。

lines.en: This wasn’t “fine” at all. This was the most hopeless she’d felt since her mother passed away — and it was all for someone who didn’t even deserve it.
lines.zh: 这一点都不「没事」。这是自她母亲去世以来，她感受过的最绝望的时刻——而这一切都是为了一个根本不配的人。

lines.en: Part of her knew that. Part of her knew that she could find someone else whenever she wanted. But she didn’t {i}want{/i} someone else. She wanted {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: 她心里有一部分明白这一点。有一部分明白，她随时都能另找一个。可她不{i}想要{/i}别人。她想要的是{i}他{/i}。

lines.en: So she’d wait and wait and wait and wait, telling herself every day that {i}this{/i} would be the day he’d let her back into his life. But no matter how long she waited, that day never came.
lines.zh: 于是她等啊等、等啊等，每天都告诉自己：{i}今天{/i}就是他重新接纳自己的日子。可无论她等多久，那一天始终没有来。

lines.en: And she was starting to worry it never would.
lines.zh: 而她开始担心，那一天永远不会来。

lines.en: She was starting to worry that someone {i}else{/i} had sunk their teeth into him...that he’d gotten bored of her. But she cared less about who that was right now and more about how to win him back.
lines.zh: 她开始担心有{i}别人{/i}已经咬住了他……担心他已经厌倦了自己。但此刻她更在意的不是那个人是谁，而是该怎么把他赢回来。

lines.en: She could clean up the mess later. She could scare someone away if she had to.
lines.zh: 烂摊子可以之后再收拾。必要的话，她可以把某人吓跑。

lines.en: Anyone but Ami, that is. Chika had resigned herself to the fact that if anything {i}were{/i} to happen to Ami, it would have to be something she physically {i}did.{/i} But again...first came winning him back.
lines.zh: 当然除了 Ami。Chika 已经认命了：如果 Ami {i}真{/i}出了什么事，那必须是她亲手{i}做{/i}的。不过再说一次……首要任务还是把他赢回来。

lines.en: If only she knew that persistence was one of his greatest weaknesses. If only these childish feelings stopped getting in the way of her beating him down until he admits how he really feels about her.
lines.zh: 要是她知道「坚持」正是他最大的弱点之一就好了。要是这些幼稚的感情别再碍事就好了——她本可以把他狠狠打服，逼他承认自己的真实感受。

lines.en: Then they could laugh and kiss and make love and he could tell her all about how she’s the echo of a life he’s always longed for.
lines.zh: 然后他们就可以大笑、亲吻、做爱，他可以告诉她，她是他一直渴望的那个人生的回声。

lines.en: But instead she’s here with her feet in the sand and her heart in her stomach as someone manages to sneak up on her without her so much as noticing.
lines.zh: 可她现在却站在沙地里，心提到了嗓子眼，而有人已经悄悄凑到了她身后，她竟完全没有察觉。

lines.en: : Chika?...
lines.zh: : Chika？……

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka2
: What are you doing out here all alone? Rin was asking about you just a moment ago.
lines.zh: : 你一个人在这儿干什么？Rin 刚才还在问起你。

lines.en: : Oh...hey, Touka. Don’t mind me. I’m just out here being miserable.
lines.zh: : 哦……嗨，Touka。别管我。我只是在这儿自怨自艾。

lines.en: : May...I ask why? Or would you prefer to keep it to yourself?
lines.zh: : 我……可以问问为什么吗？还是你更想一个人憋着？

lines.en: : You can ask. But fair warning, it’ll probably turn into a big thing where I just rant and complain and make myself look like an idiot for the next hour. So run away now if you want to save yourself.
lines.zh: : 你可以问。不过提前警告，这很可能会演变成一大段——我就这么发牢骚、抱怨，接下来一个小时都在出丑。所以想自救的话，现在就跑吧。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka3
: I have time. Yasu’s with Molly tonight, so I’m free to listen to anyone who wants to make themselves sound like an idiot for any amount of hours.
lines.zh: : 我有时间。Yasu 今晚跟 Molly 在一起，所以我可以随便听谁出丑，听多少小时都行。

lines.en: : Besides, there’s something I’ve wanted to ask you as well. But not until you’re done getting all of that {i}misery{/i} out of your system.
lines.zh: : 再说，我也有一件事想问你。不过得等你把那些{i}苦水{/i}全倒完再说。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Thanks, Touka...but, fair warning part two, it involves boys.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Touka……不过，第二道警告：这事跟男生有关。

lines.en: : As in...multiple?
lines.zh: : 你是说……多个？

lines.en: : Mmm...more like zero right now. Ideally one, but currently zero. And not multiple unless this specific boy wanted to get really freaky and it was only a one time thing that he was also involved in.
lines.zh: : 嗯……现在更像是零个。理想是一个，目前是零个。除非这个特定的男生想玩点特别的，而且只玩一次、他自己也参与，那才能算多个。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka4
: Now please stop me before my hormones spiral further out of control and I forever taint your pure heart with a more vivid description of exactly what would happen if-
lines.zh: : 现在请务必打断我，免得我的激素继续失控，害你纯洁的心灵永远被我绘声绘色地污染——要真那样会发生什么的话——

lines.en: : Silence, peasant. You are in the presence of royalty.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，庶民。你面前站着的是王族。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka5
: Thank you. I’m not sure if classism was really necessary though.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。不过我不确定真的有必要搞阶级歧视。

lines.en: : Apologies. Everyone always used to shut their mouth when my mother would say that, so it was the first thing I thought of to make you do the same.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。以前我母亲说这句话的时候，所有人都会立刻闭嘴，所以这是我能想到的、让你也闭嘴的第一句话。

lines.en: : Now tell me, what’s going on with you and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 现在告诉我，你和 Sensei 之间怎么了？

lines.en: : All I said was “boy.” I never said it was him. But for the sake of the conversation, we can pretend that it is. So I will now say “Sensei” instead of “boy” just to make sure I don’t confuse you.
lines.zh: : 我只说了「男生」。我从没说过是他。不过为了方便讨论，我们可以假设是他。所以接下来我会说「Sensei」而不是「男生」，免得把你弄糊涂。

lines.en: : I’m very grateful that you’d do such a thing for me, Chika. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 你愿意为我做到这种地步，我非常感激，Chika。谢谢你。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka6
: Touka, I’m so confused. Like...what am I supposed to do if my boyfriend never wants to spend any time with me anymore? How do I make him...want to do that again?
lines.zh: : Touka，我好困惑。就是……如果我男朋友再也不想跟我待在一起了，我该怎么办？我该怎么让他……重新想那么做？

lines.en: : Do you really think {i}I’m{/i} the one to ask such a question? I’d rarely even associated with males before high school. And since then it’s been almost exclusively teachers.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得问{i}我{/i}这种问题合适吗？上高中之前我几乎没和男性打过交道。之后也几乎只有老师。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re smart and pretty and I’m sure you must have had to fend off at least a dozen confessions at your old school.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你又聪明又漂亮，我敢肯定你在以前的学校至少得挡掉十几次告白。

lines.en: : Well, you shouldn’t be as no such thing has ever happened to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你不该这么肯定，因为我身上从没发生过这种事。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka7
: Not even once? Really?
lines.zh: : 一次都没有？真的？

lines.en: : I believe...{i}intimidating{/i} is the word I used to hear in regard to my presence?
lines.zh: : 我记得……以前别人形容我的存在感，用的词好像是「{i}令人战栗{/i}」？

lines.en: : I can’t imagine many boys would fall for a girl whose parents could have them killed at a moment’s notice.
lines.zh: : 我很难想象会有多少男生敢喜欢一个——她父母随时可以要他们命的女孩。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka8
: Well, at least I’m not alone in being completely unapproachable.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少在「完全没人敢靠近」这一点上我不是一个人。

lines.en: : You’re far from {i}unapproachable,{/i} Chika. I’m sure it’s just a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 你可一点都不「{i}没人敢靠近{/i}」，Chika。我相信这只是个误会。

lines.en: : Then it’s the longest fucking misunderstanding ever. Sorry for the language.
lines.zh: : 那这他妈的是史上最长的误会。抱歉我说脏话。

lines.en: : Please don’t apologize for not censoring yourself around me. I’m not your mother.
lines.zh: : 请不要为了在我面前没管住嘴而道歉。我又不是你母亲。

lines.en: : I wish you were.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你是。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka9
: Many do.
lines.zh: : 很多人都这么希望。

lines.en: : No, I just mean...this is the exact sort of situation my mom would have been perfect for. Figuring this out on my own {i}sucks.{/i} Nothing works. I’m so...fucking lost.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是说……这种情况恰恰是我妈妈最擅长的。自己一个人想办法真是{i}烂透了{/i}。什么都没用。我……他妈的好迷茫。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka10
: {i}My{/i} mother is there if you really need her, Chika. She’s told you this before, hasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 如果你真的需要，{i}我的{/i}母亲随时都在，Chika。她以前跟你说过的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...and honestly, I’ve been thinking of calling her and stuff. But, like...she’s always busy. And I feel bad about dragging her into this stuff when it’ll all probably sound dumb to her.
lines.zh: : 嗯……说实话，我一直想给她打电话什么的。可是……她总是很忙。而且把这些事拖她下水我会过意不去，她大概只会觉得幼稚。

lines.en: : I can assure that wouldn’t be the case at all. But seeing as she’s not here right now, I do hope I can be a suitable replacement. We {i}are{/i} very similar, you know.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，绝对不会。不过既然她现在不在这儿，我希望我能当个合格的替补。我们俩很像，你知道的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I do have a hard time shaking the fact that you’re my classmate, but I guess you two are really similar apart from that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我确实很难摆脱「你是我同学」这个事实，不过除此之外你们俩真的挺像的。

lines.en: : What do you think she would do in my shoes, Touka? How would Tsubasa handle it if a boy she was dating just...started phasing her out?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她要是处在我的位置会怎么做，Touka？如果 Tsubasa 交往的男生开始慢慢疏远她，她会怎么处理？

lines.en: : Chika...I’m not sure you actually want to hear the answer to that question.
lines.zh: : Chika……我不确定你真的想听这个问题的答案。

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t I? I’ll take anything at this point.
lines.zh: : 为什么不想？我现在什么都听得进去。

lines.en: : No. You’ll take anything that will {i}help.{/i} Hearing {i}actual{/i} advice about what a strong woman would do when faced with such an issue will only {i}scare{/i} you. I don’t want to do that.
lines.zh: : 不。你听得进去的是{i}有用{/i}的东西。听一个坚强的女人在这种处境下{i}真正{/i}会怎么做，只会{i}吓到{/i}你。我不想那样。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka11
: {i}Scare{/i} me?...
: That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : So...I’m screwed? Am I just a step or two away from being dumped now? Is {i}that{/i} what’s going on? There’s nothing I can do?
lines.zh: : 那……我完蛋了？我是不是离被甩只剩一两步了？{i}就是那样{/i}了吗？我什么都做不了？

lines.en: : It’s less what you {i}can{/i} do and more what you {i}should{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 与其说你能做什么，不如说你{i}该{/i}做什么。

lines.en: : Can you just put it bluntly? I’m bad at using my brain when I’m sad.
lines.zh: : 你能不能直说？我难过的时候脑子不好使。

lines.en: : How about I ask you a question instead? Chika...do you think you deserve to be treated this way?
lines.zh: : 那我换个方式问你吧？Chika……你觉得你该被这样对待吗？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}no.{/i} I think I’m a great girlfriend. But I have no idea what Sensei thinks. What if he doesn’t see me that way?
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}不该{/i}。我觉得我是个很棒的女朋友。可我不知道 Sensei 怎么想。万一他不这么看我呢？

lines.en: : If he doesn’t see you that way, is he truly the man you want to be with? Or do you think it would be better for {i}you{/i} if he {i}were{/i} to “phase you out?”
lines.zh: : 如果他不这么看你，他真的是你想共度一生的人吗？还是说，被他「慢慢疏远」对{i}你{/i}反而更好？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka12
: Being phased out is the {i}last{/i} thing I want. That’s the worst possible outcome. Just {i}thinking{/i} about it makes me want to break down in tears. I have to avoid that by any means possible.
lines.zh: : 被疏远是我{i}最不想要{/i}的结果。那是最糟的结局。光是{i}想想{/i}我就想哭。我必须不惜一切避免那种事。

lines.en: : So you’ll continue to subject yourself to something clearly torturing you all for a chance to be with him?
lines.zh: : 所以你打算继续承受这种明显在折磨你的东西，只为换一个和他在一起的机会？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka13
: Mhm...
: Chika...forgive me, but that is so incredibly stupid.
lines.zh: : Chika……恕我直言，这实在蠢得不可思议。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka14
: It’s not, though! I love him! I’d do anything for him!
lines.zh: : 才不是！我爱他！我愿意为他做任何事！

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka15
: But how long will you do anything {i}for?{/i} If you’ve been chasing his shadow to no avail for months on end, wouldn’t it make more sense to focus on someone who {i}would{/i} value your time?
lines.zh: : 可你愿意「{i}为{/i}」多久？如果你徒劳地追着他的影子追了好几个月，把精力放在一个会珍惜你时间的人身上，不是更合理吗？

lines.en: : Our lives are far too short to waste on those who don’t want us.
lines.zh: : 我们的人生太短了，不值得浪费在那些不想要我们的人身上。

lines.en: : So you think...{i}he doesn’t want me anymore?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得……{i}他不想要我了？{/i}……

lines.en: : Chika...we are talking about a man in his thirties who does not yet even {i}know{/i} what he wants out of life, let alone romance. We can’t expect him to always make sense.
lines.zh: : Chika……我们说的是一个三十多岁的男人，他连自己想从人生里得到什么都不{i}知道{/i}，更别提爱情了。我们不能指望他永远讲道理。

lines.en: : And if that is not something you’re comfortable with, wouldn’t it be smarter to just...move on?
lines.zh: : 如果你接受不了这一点，干脆放手不是更明智吗？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka16
: Of course it would be smarter! But I wouldn’t have started seeing him in the first place if being “smart” was something I cared about here!
lines.zh: : 当然更明智！可如果我在意的是「明智」，我一开始就不会跟他在一起了！

lines.en: : That’s not entirely true...Smart as you are, you’re still young. We both are. It’s expected for us to be impulsive and...make poor decisions at this age.
lines.zh: : 也不完全对……你再怎么聪明，也还是年轻。我们都年轻。在这个年纪冲动、做出糟糕的决定，是很正常的。

lines.en: : But just because you make a poor decision doesn’t mean it needs to become an albatross. You can shoot it down whenever you like.
lines.zh: : 但做出一个糟糕的决定，不代表它必须变成一只信天翁。你随时可以把它射下来。

lines.en: : What’s an albatross?
lines.zh: : 信天翁是什么？

lines.en: : It’s a...bird. Forgive me for the dated analogy. I’m just trying to tell you that-
lines.zh: : 是……一种鸟。抱歉，这个比喻有点过时了。我只是想告诉你——

lines.en: : Things like this will continue to happen so long as you stay with him...So that’s something you must be prepared for.
lines.zh: : 只要你跟他在一起，这种事就会不断发生……所以你得对此有心理准备。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka17
: Is this really the type of girl you are, Chika? One who sits alone on the beach, venting about her problems? Because I could have sworn you were more proactive than that.
lines.zh: : 你真的是这样的女孩吗，Chika？一个人坐在沙滩上，倾诉自己的烦恼？我记得你可比这主动多了。

lines.en: : I could have sworn that, out of anyone, {i}you{/i} would be the type to run that man down until he has no {i}choice{/i} but to speak to you. Is that not the case? Have {i}you{/i} changed as well?
lines.zh: : 我记得，所有人里最可能把那个男人追到走投无路、迫使他{i}不得不{/i}开口的，恰恰是{i}你{/i}。难道不是吗？连{i}你{/i}也变了吗？

lines.en: : I want to run him down...I really do.
lines.zh: : 我想追他……真的想。

lines.en: : Then why are you {i}here?{/i} You’ve already figured out he’s at the beach, yes? He’s readily available. {i}Go to him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还在{i}这儿{/i}？你已经打听到他在海滩上了，对吧？他就在那儿，随你去找。{i}去吧{/i}。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka18
: But, Touka...
lines.zh: : 可是，Touka……

lines.en: : I’m {i}scared...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我{i}好害怕……{/i}

lines.en: : Of what?...
lines.zh: : 怕什么？……

lines.en: : Of what I’ll find out...
lines.zh: : 怕我会发现什么……

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka19
: Like...what if there’s someone else now? What if {i}that’s{/i} why he’s avoiding me?! I’ve been...there have been some flags lately. Maybe longer than lately. I don’t know. But there are flags.
lines.zh: : 比如……万一他现在有别人了呢？万一他{i}就是因为{/i}这个才躲着我？！我……最近有些不对劲的迹象。也许比「最近」还早。我不知道。但确实有迹象。

lines.en: : And I...have no idea what I’d do if...that’s the truth. I love him {i}so{/i} much. I’ve been so loyal. And I thought he was too, but- no. No, I don’t know he’s not yet. This is crazy talk, right? Right?
lines.zh: : 而我……不知道如果那是真的我该怎么办。我{i}那么{/i}爱他。我一直那么忠诚。我以为他也是，可是——不。不，我还不知道他不是。这是胡思乱想吧？对吧？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka20
: Tell me I’m being crazy, Touka. Tell me it’s all in my head. It’s all in my head, right?! He’d never {i}actually{/i} cheat on me. Right? He loves me! He’s said it a million times!
lines.zh: : 告诉我我在发疯，Touka。告诉我一切都是我脑补的。都是我脑补的，对吧？！他绝对不会{i}真的{/i}劈腿我。对吧？他爱我！他说过无数次了！

lines.en: : And I’m sure he meant it, but...
lines.zh: : 我相信他说的是真心话，可是……

lines.en: : Love can be a complicated thing.
lines.zh: : 爱是一件复杂的事。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if there are any two people in the world with the same definition of that word.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这世上有没有两个人对这个词的定义是一样的。

lines.en: : B...But even if I {i}do{/i} run him down, he probably won’t even talk to me! Why won’t he let me share this pain with him if there’s so fucking much of it?!
lines.zh: : 可……可就算我{i}真的{/i}追上他，他大概也不会理我！既然有这么多痛苦，他为什么不肯让我和他一起分担？！

lines.en: : Have you considered that maybe he’s just trying to protect you?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，他也许只是在保护你？

lines.en: : Of course! But he doesn’t {i}have{/i} to! I can take it! The two of us can work through it together!
lines.zh: : 当然想过！可他没那个{i}必要{/i}！我受得住！我们两个人可以一起扛过去！

lines.en: : But if...if there’s someone else...
lines.zh: : 但如果……如果有别人……

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka21
: Touka...I am {i}so{/i} fucking scared that he’d share his pain with someone other than me...
lines.zh: : Touka……我他妈好害怕，怕他把痛苦倾诉给除我以外的人……

lines.en: : And so the {i}last{/i} thing I want to do is annoy him because I don’t want that to be the tipping point that makes him throw me away altogether.
lines.zh: : 所以我{i}最不想{/i}做的就是惹他烦，因为我不想让那成为压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草，让他彻底把我甩掉。

lines.en: : Well...
: Let me just say that I don’t know Sensei as well as you, so feel free to take this with a grain of salt-
lines.zh: : 我先声明，我没有你那么了解 Sensei，所以这番话你大可打个折扣听——

lines.en: : But I highly doubt he would ever just {i}throw you away.{/i} For all you know, you could be far more important to him than you even understand.
lines.zh: : 但我很怀疑他会就这么{i}把你甩掉{/i}。说不定，你对他来说比你以为的重要得多。

lines.en: : So I say {i}go annoy him{/i} if you’re positive he’s the one you want. But {i}only{/i} if you’re positive- for good things don’t come to those who wait. They come to those who {i}act.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以我说，如果你确定他就是你想要的人，那就{i}去烦他{/i}吧。但前提是你确定——因为好事不会降临在等待的人身上。它们降临在{i}行动{/i}的人身上。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka22
: If there {i}is{/i} someone else...
lines.zh: : 如果{i}真的{/i}有别人……

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do if it’s someone I {i}know?{/i}
lines.zh: : 要是那个人是我{i}认识{/i}的人，我该怎么办？

lines.en: : What would you {i}want{/i} to do?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}怎么做？

lines.en: : Throw them into the back of a trunk and drive off a cliff.
lines.zh: : 把她们塞进后备箱，然后开车冲下悬崖。

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t do that...
lines.zh: : 你大概不该那么做……

lines.en: : You asked.
lines.zh: : 是你问的。

lines.en: : I did, didn’t I?...
lines.zh: : 我确实问了，不是吗？……

lines.en: : I really wish my mom was here. Or Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我妈妈在这儿。或者 Tsubasa。

lines.en: : Yes, I’m beginning to think my mother would have done a better job at this than I did.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我开始觉得我母亲在这件事上会比我做得好。

lines.en: : She’s just...a lot more gentle. But I’m sure you’ll be great at stuff like this when you have a daughter one day.
lines.zh: : 她只是……温柔得多。不过我相信你将来有了女儿，也会很擅长这种事的。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka23
: Thank you, Chika...I’m sure you will as well. Though, I suppose you’re already a bit of a mother when it comes to Chinami. And...even Yumi to a slightly lesser extent.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Chika……我相信你也会。不过话说回来，对 Chinami 而言你已经算是个母亲了。甚至对 Yumi 来说，也差不太多。

lines.en: : I’d like an actual daughter too one day. Sensei will take some convincing, though. If he doesn’t dump me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我也希望有一天能有个真正的女儿。不过 Sensei 得好好劝劝。当然，如果他没甩了我的话。

lines.en: : Just go talk to him...that’s the best advice I can give.
lines.zh: : 去跟他谈谈吧……这是我能给的最好的建议。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka24
: Maybe after {i}you’re{/i} done. You had something you wanted to ask me about too, right?
lines.zh: : 也许等{i}你{/i}问完再说。你也有事想问我，对吧？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka25
: Did I say that?
lines.zh: : 我有说过吗？

lines.en: : Girl, it’s fine. I’ve done nothing but ramble on this whole time. It’s your turn to come to me. You’ve earned it.
lines.zh: : 姐们儿，没事的。我这一路除了唠叨什么都没做。现在轮到你来找我了。这是你应得的。

lines.en: : Yes, but I’m not entirely sure the subject I wanted to ask you about is appropriate given everything we just discussed and how...{i}damaged{/i} your current mental state is.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，但考虑到我们刚才聊了什么，还有你现在的心理状态有多么「{i}受损{/i}」，我不太确定我想问的话题合不合适。

lines.en: : Touka. Ask me your fucking question.
lines.zh: : Touka。把你那该死的问题问出来。

lines.en: : Well...{i}okay.{/i} But it’s extremely and contextually inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 那……{i}好吧{/i}。不过这个话题极其不合时宜。

lines.en: : I think I can handle it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我受得住。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka26
: How do you have sex with a boy?
lines.zh: : 要怎么跟男生做爱？

lines.en: : You...
: You don’t know...how sex works?
lines.zh: : 你不知道……性是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka27
: O-Of course I know how it works! I’ve just never...{i}done{/i} it before...
lines.zh: : 我……我当然知道是怎么回事！我只是从来没……{i}做过{/i}……

lines.en: : So I don’t know if there’s something specific that...boys {i}like{/i} or...if there’s anything I should {i}do.{/i} And I know that you’re experienced, so...
lines.zh: : 所以我不知道男生有没有什么特别……{i}喜欢{/i}的东西，或者……有没有什么我该{i}做{/i}的。而我知道你很有经验，所以……

lines.en: : Are you...going to sleep with somebody?
lines.zh: : 你……打算跟谁上床了？

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka28
: Well...{i}eventually.{/i} Though I’m...not quite sure {i}when{/i} given the...current....{i}political climate.{/i} But...I suppose I should learn. For when it...actually happens.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}早晚吧{/i}。虽然考虑到……目前的……{i}政治局面{/i}的话，我不太确定是{i}什么时候{/i}。不过……我想我该学着点。为了真到了那一天的时候。

lines.en: scene chikabeachtouka29
: I told you it was inappropriate!
lines.zh: : 我就说不合时宜吧！

lines.en: : Sorry, it’s just cute seeing you like this. We’ve never had real “girl talk” before. I’d be more than happy to teach you about sex, Touka.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，只是看你这样子太可爱了。我们以前从来没有过真正的「闺蜜谈话」。我非常乐意教你关于性的事，Touka。

lines.en: : And I’d be more than happy to learn!
lines.zh: : 而我也非常乐意学习！

lines.en: scene black
: Okay! Then, first thing’s first, are you an S or an M?
lines.zh: : 好！那么，首先第一个问题，你是 S 还是 M？

lines.en: : F...Female?...
: Mh...pffffft! Hahahaha! Female?!
lines.zh: : 嗯……噗哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈！女性？！

lines.en: : D...Don’t laugh at me! That question wasn’t covered in any of the resource materials I was provided!
lines.zh: : 别……别笑我！我拿到的那些资料里可没涵盖这个问题！

lines.en: : Ohhhh man...Buckle up, sister.
lines.zh: : 哦豁，老妹……系好安全带。

lines.en: : This might take a while...
lines.zh: : 这可能要讲上好一阵子……

lines.en: And so Chika spends the next hour teaching Touka how to properly cuck her — a thing she definitely won’t regret later on in life.
lines.zh: 于是接下来的一小时，Chika 都在教 Touka 该怎么正儿八经地给她戴绿帽——这件事她日后绝对不会后悔。
